purpose: Real-time market data ingestion architecture: Alpaca/Coinbase WebSocket -> event normalization -> time-series persistence -> indicators -> FastAPI/WebSocket UI
latencySuitability: MEDIUM-HIGH as a server-side architectural pattern; not suitable for direct GitHub Pages integration
maintenance: Created 2026-03-28; last visible push 2026-04-01. README is substantial and backend includes adapters/tests, but maintenance has been inactive for about five months and the repository has no visible adoption signal.
securityNotes: Alpaca credentials are correctly modeled as server-side environment secrets, but any TAGX adaptation must keep them entirely off GitHub Pages/browser code. The adapter authenticates over TLS and uses ping/ping-timeout. No direct production use because repository has no detected license and limited maintenance history.
dataRequirements: Alpaca API credentials and feed entitlement for equities; IEX free feed is not equivalent to consolidated full-market coverage. Postgres/TimescaleDB adds deployment/ops cost.
lookAheadRisk: MEDIUM unless source event timestamp and receive timestamp are both persisted. Adapter falls back to local current time if provider timestamp parsing fails; TAGX must NOT copy that fallback for training/replay truth because it can corrupt causal ordering.
latencyNotes: WebSocket transport is appropriate for sub-minute detection, but database/indicator batching must be benchmarked. README default BATCH_INTERVAL_MS=100 and HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_S=30 are useful observability ideas, not validated TAGX settings.
reason: Useful server-side streaming/health architecture, but no detected license, stale maintenance, zero visible adoption, and Alpaca entitlement dependence make direct integration inferior to the already-registered official alpaca-py candidate. Borrow only normalized event adapters, feed-health endpoints, heartbeat concepts, and explicit server-side secret separation.
